products.name: Avakaya (Mango Pickle)
products.description: The king of Andhra pickles! Raw mango pieces marinated in mustard powder, red chili, and cold-pressed sesame oil.

products.name: Gongura Pickle
products.description: Tangy sorrel leaves tempered with green chili, garlic, and fenugreek seeds in sesame oil.

products.name: Lemon Pickle
products.description: Sun-ripened lemons cured with rock salt, turmeric, and a fiery red chili blend.

products.name: Tomato Pickle
products.description: Ripe tomatoes slow-cooked with aromatic spices, tamarind, and jaggery.

products.name: Garlic Pickle
products.description: Plump garlic cloves roasted and marinated in a bold masala of red chili, mustard, and vinegar.

products.name: Amla Pickle
products.description: Indian gooseberries preserved with mustard seeds, fenugreek, and turmeric. Rich in Vitamin C.

products.name: Mixed Vegetable Pickle
products.description: A colorful medley of raw mango, carrot, cauliflower, and green chili in a fragrant mustard-oil base.

products.name: Red Chili Pickle
products.description: Stuffed Guntur red chilis filled with tangy tamarind-spice paste.

products.name: Ginger Pickle
products.description: Fresh ginger slices marinated in lemon juice, green chili, and sesame oil.

products.name: Prawn Pickle
products.description: Fresh Bhimavaram prawns marinated in a fiery red masala with garlic, ginger, and curry leaves.

products.name: Chicken Pickle
products.description: Artisanal farm-fresh boneless chicken morsels slow-braised in cold-pressed sesame oil, Guntur red chilies, roasted coriander, and heritage Andhra spice blend. Naturally cured in traditional porcelain jars.

products.name: Mutton Pickle
products.description: Bone-in mutton morsels braised in a rich masala of red chili, garam masala, and cold-pressed oil.

products.name: Fish Pickle
products.description: Firm white fish fillets fried golden and marinated in tangy tamarind-chili paste.

products.name: Egg Pickle
products.description: Hard-boiled eggs halved and soaked in a vibrant, tangy masala gravy.

products.name: Crab Pickle
products.description: Fresh river crab from the Krishna delta, cleaned and marinated in a robust chili-garlic paste.

products.name: Shrimp Paste Pickle
products.description: Traditional Andhra shrimp paste blended with red chili, tamarind, and roasted peanuts.

products.name: Chicken Liver Pickle
products.description: Chicken livers pan-seared and folded into a tangy vinegar-based pickle.

products.name: Dried Fish Pickle
products.description: Sun-dried fish reconstituted in a tangy masala with fenugreek and curry leaves.
